descriptions.zh-Hans: 在首尔尝辣炒年糕后写的卡片，旁边画了我那只安静又可靠的水杯。
descriptions.en: A card from trying tteokbokki in Seoul, with my quiet, dependable water glass drawn alongside.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在首尔广藏市场尝绿豆煎饼后留的小菜单，一个“咔”替我记住自己那一口的声音。
descriptions.en: My menu from a mung bean pancake at Seoul’s Gwangjang Market. A tiny “crk” remembers the edge of my serving.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在首尔昌德宫散步后记的个人路线，箭头没有拉直，起点添了一颗小星。
descriptions.en: My own route note after a walk at Changdeokgung in Seoul. The arrows keep their turns, with a star marking the start.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 尝过首尔辣炒年糕后留下的水杯小画。那个“辣”字，写得比别的字更有精神。
descriptions.en: A water-glass doodle from tteokbokki in Seoul. The word “spicy” carries the liveliest handwriting on the sheet.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在首尔清溪川边，我和旅人同走一小段后留下的两道短线。目的地只是下一座桥。
descriptions.en: Two short lines for a brief walk with another traveler beside Cheonggyecheon in Seoul. The next bridge was far enough.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 由昌德宫散步便签折成的小卡，装着我自己的转弯记忆。合上后，起点的小星还在外面。
descriptions.en: A card folded from my Changdeokgung walking note. It holds my own remembered turns; the starting star stays outside.
